description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koongahamankada, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No.620004
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed land parcel numbers, locations, extents, and ownership details (all registered to "The State" or one private individual). The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
